intro.name: Supakorn Ieamgomol
intro.title: Software Engineer Intern
intro.summary: Third-year Information Technology student at KMUTT and part-time Software Engineer Intern at Agoda, working on a Kotlin/Ktor service template and its end-to-end development workflow. Previously built a C#/.NET OTA integration and an AI-assisted grading MVP at SIT.

projects.name: MMORPG Shop
details: Independently built an MMORPG shop backend across auth, player, item, inventory, and payment services.
Applied DDD boundaries and handler, use-case, and repository layers to organize each service.
Implemented Kafka-based buy and sell workflows that update player balances and inventory, with rollback for failed steps.
Added REST and gRPC APIs with JWT authentication, role-based access control, and MongoDB persistence.

contributions.name: Goyave
details: Contributed custom ListenConfig support for advanced server configuration.

contributions.name: Pruna
details: Migrated project-wide static type checking from mypy to ty and updated Python annotations.
Implemented end-to-end support for a new OTA integration across four backend microservices and the BFF.
Built mapping and validation logic to translate OTA data into Agoda’s internal property model.
Added unit and integration tests for the new OTA import flow across affected services.
Diagnosed data issues during an early A/B experiment by tracing application logs and requests in Grafana.
Independently built a research proof of concept for teachers to manage exams, answer keys, rubrics, and student submissions.
Added AI assistance for rubric creation and student-answer grading, including an explanation for each score.
Implemented protected teacher workflows with input validation and role-based access control.
